root_cause.text: The `smb2_get_ea` function in the ksmbd subsystem lacks a bounds check before applying 4-byte alignment padding via `memset`, permitting writes past the buffer limit when the preceding data copy exhausts the available space.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states the alignment `memset` "fires unconditionally afterward with no check on remaining space," while the patch diff adds the validation `if (buf_free_len < alignment_bytes)` immediately prior to the `memset` call.
